mapper.select: select user_code, user_type, healthstars, healthstars_events from yh_health_star where user_code = #{userCode} order by events_time desc

select reg.user_code as `userCode`,reg.user_name as `usernmae`,reg.name as `name`,str.user_type as `userType`, str.healthstars as `healthstars`,step.healthlevelstars as `healthstarsEvents` from yh_user_reginfo as reg inner join yh_health_star as str on reg.user_code = str.user_code inner join yh_user_step as step on str.user_code = step.user_code where reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{orgCode},'%') and reg.User_Type=5
AND reg.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND step.healthlevelstars BETWEEN #{priceMin} AND #{priceMax}
group by reg.user_code order by step.healthlevelstars desc

SELECT reg.user_code as userCode, reg.user_name as usernmae, reg.`name`, SUM( IF ( str.user_type = 4, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) AS expenditure, SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 5, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) AS income, ( SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 5, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) - SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 4, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) ) AS healthstarsEvents FROM yh_user_reginfo AS reg LEFT JOIN yh_health_star AS str ON reg.user_code = str.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card AS card ON card.User_Code = reg.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_admin_info AS yuai ON yuai.id = card.doctor
reg.User_Type=5
and yuai.user_code=#{orgCode} and reg.User_Type=5
and reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{orgCode1},'%')
AND reg.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
GROUP BY reg.user_code HAVING 1=1
AND healthstarsEvents < #{priceMax}
AND healthstarsEvents > #{priceMin}
ORDER BY healthstarsEvents DESC
